images.filename: 皇后大道東186至190號, 186-190 Queen's Road East, 2018.jpg
images.caption:
The Tong Lau (Chinese Tenement) on 186-190 Queen's Road East was built in the late 1930s.
It consists of three tenements, with 4 storeys and balconies in front, and was built on the reclaimed land of 1887.

The buildings has now been revitalized and provide store area for the Kee Wah Bakery.
images.alt:

images.caption:
The Chinese tenement of "6 Stewart Road" is located at the corner of Jaffe Road and Stewart Road.
It is a pre-war building finished in the 1920s, as one of the few remaining corner tenement houses nowadays in Hong Kong.
